_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for Remote Config in PRODUCTION (divit-6d217).
Publish with: npm run rc:publish -- prod
This file is published to BOTH Remote Config namespaces:
firebase         (client)  — read by the app's JS SDK: minimum_supported_version
firebase-server  (server)  — read by getServerTemplate() in Cloud Functions:
Publishing only one namespace is the trap this file exists to close: the
Firebase console shows the CLIENT template by default, so setting
paywall_enabled there reaches no server code and the caps silently never

paywall_enabled.description: Master switch for free-tier cap ENFORCEMENT. false = evaluate and log only (dark launch). Ships false.

free_active_groups.description: Max owned ACTIVE events on the free tier. Clamped to [1,1000] server-side.

free_scans_per_month.description: Max AI receipt scans per UTC month on the free tier. Clamped to [1,1000] server-side.

minimum_supported_version_ios.description: Lowest iOS app version allowed to run. EMPTY = no floor = nobody is walled. iOS currently ships 1.0 (MARKETING_VERSION). Only ever set to a version already live in the App Store.

minimum_supported_version_android.description: Lowest Android app version allowed to run. EMPTY = no floor = nobody is walled. Android currently ships 1.3 (versionName). Only ever set to a version already live on Google Play.
